first.pick: Which famous first is {label} credited with?
first.match: Match each explorer to their famous first.
first.reverse: Who is credited with this famous first: {value}?

rows.label: Neil Armstrong
rows.first: First to walk on the Moon
rows.hook: commanded the Apollo 11 mission and stepped onto the lunar surface with a famous line

rows.label: Amelia Earhart
rows.first: First woman to fly solo across the Atlantic
rows.hook: vanished over the Pacific during an attempt to fly around the globe

rows.label: Wright brothers
rows.first: First to make a powered airplane flight
rows.hook: were Ohio bicycle makers who tested gliders and their Flyer on the dunes near Kitty Hawk

rows.label: James Cook
rows.first: First to sail across the Antarctic Circle
rows.description: British explorer, cartographer and naval officer (1728–1779)
rows.hook: led three Pacific voyages and charted the coasts of New Zealand and eastern Australia

rows.label: Felix Baumgartner
rows.first: First skydiver to break the speed of sound in freefall
rows.description: Austrian skydiver, daredevil and BASE jumper (1969–2025)

rows.label: Charles Lindbergh
rows.first: First to fly solo nonstop across the Atlantic
rows.description: American aviator, author, inventor, explorer, and social activist (1902–1974)
rows.hook: piloted the Spirit of St. Louis from New York to Paris and became a worldwide celebrity

rows.label: Yuri Gagarin
rows.description: Soviet pilot and cosmonaut, first human in space (1934–1968)
rows.hook: orbited the planet once aboard Vostok 1 in a 108-minute flight

rows.label: Ferdinand Magellan
rows.first: First European to sail from the Atlantic into the Pacific
rows.description: Portuguese explorer in the service of Spain
rows.hook: led the expedition whose surviving crew completed the first voyage around the world, though he died on the way

rows.label: Vasco da Gama
rows.first: First to sail from Europe to India
rows.hook: opened the sea route around the Cape of Good Hope to Kozhikode

rows.label: Leif Erikson
rows.first: First European to reach North America
rows.hook: is a Viking explorer nicknamed the Lucky who is linked to the settlement of Vinland

rows.label: John Glenn
rows.first: First American to orbit the Earth
rows.hook: circled the globe three times in Friendship 7, then returned to space at age 77 and served as a senator

rows.label: Sally Ride
rows.hook: flew aboard the Challenger shuttle and later became a physicist and science educator

rows.label: Reinhold Messner
rows.first: First to climb all fourteen of the world's 8,000-metre peaks

rows.label: Chuck Yeager
rows.first: First pilot to fly faster than the speed of sound
rows.description: American World War II flying ace and test pilot; first pilot to fly faster than sound (1923–2020)
rows.hook: pushed the Bell X-1 past Mach 1 and was portrayed in The Right Stuff

rows.label: Roald Amundsen
rows.first: First to reach the South Pole
rows.description: Norwegian explorer; first person to reach the South Pole (1872–1928)
rows.hook: beat Robert Falcon Scott in a race to the bottom of the world and navigated the Northwest Passage

rows.label: Valentina Tereshkova
rows.description: Russian cosmonaut and pilot, first woman to have flown in space (born 1937)
rows.hook: flew solo on Vostok 6 and orbited the Earth dozens of times

rows.label: Alan Shepard
rows.description: American astronaut, first American in space, lunar explorer (1923–1998)
rows.hook: flew a short suborbital Mercury hop and later hit golf balls on the lunar surface

rows.label: Bessie Coleman
rows.first: First Black woman to earn a pilot's licence
